knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The material has to be identified and the label or safety data sheet checked before a product is chosen. Choosing the strongest product risks damage, a test in the middle of the seat is not a hidden area, and the lesson does not make the customer the decision-maker on product choice.

Liquid stays off the display. Product goes onto a cloth first, and a dry or lightly dampened microfibre cloth is used on the screen. Spraying onto the display and soaking a towel both put liquid where it can reach electronics, and a dressing straight from the bottle risks marks.

The detailer stops work on that system, records the light as found, and tells the customer, who arranges inspection by a qualified repairer. Resetting, clearing a code or diagnosing the fault is outside detailing work.
A dry interior with any remaining damp area checked and recorded is the handover standard. Damp seats left to dry later, or protectant sealed onto wet material, trap moisture.

practicalCriteria: Identifies three interior surfaces (for example fabric, coated or synthetic leather, and vinyl or plastic trim) and records the material for each before any product is chosen.
Runs a hidden-area test on one surface, and records the product, dwell time and result after the test area has dried.
Cleans a simulated screen using product applied to a cloth. No liquid contacts the simulated screen, controls or sensor.
On a simulated warning light and a simulated loose cover with a wire, stops work, photographs and records both as found, and refers both to a qualified repairer without resetting or touching them.
Checks seats, mats and the floor for damp patches before handover, and records the result.
passRule: Materials recorded before product choice, a test-area result recorded, no liquid on any screen, control, sensor or airbag area, warning light or loose item stopped and referred without reset, and dry handover recorded. Observed by an assessor against the practical criteria. Not an automotive, airbag or electrical licence, and a quiz pass is not verified practical competence.
evidenceRequired: Interior material record for each surface, with the product and label or safety data sheet reference
Test-area record: location, product, dwell time and result
Photographs and written record of the simulated warning light and loose cover, with the referral
stopWorkCriteria: Liquid sprayed onto a screen, control, sensor or airbag area
Airbag cover, airbag module or exposed wiring disturbed, pressed or removed
Warning light, fault message or code reset, cleared or diagnosed by the detailer
Heat used to speed a product in a closed cabin
Glossy or greasy product applied to leather or trim without the owner's written instruction and label support
Protectant applied to damp fabric or to any surface the label does not list
